breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the erroneous claim that the slope vanishes at the supports. It does not repeat the incorrect boundary condition from the incomplete prompt. Instead, it simply states that 'the slope at the supports will be computed,' which aligns with the ground truth prompt that asks to compute (rather than assume zero) the slope at the supports.
